wizard.title: Set up your job search in 30 seconds
wizard.lead: Three quick steps so we can find roles for you across Indeed, StepStone, Arbeitnow, Muse, and more.
wizard.step1.title: 1. Add your CV
wizard.step1.lead: Optional — paste plain text or upload a file. We'll auto-suggest the best persona.
wizard.step2.title: 2. Confirm your persona
wizard.step2.lead: Pick what best describes the role you want. We pre-selected the closest match.
wizard.step3.title: 3. Tell us what you're looking for
wizard.step3.lead: A role keyword + a city. We watch the major aggregators daily and email you matches.
wizard.step3.roleRequired: Add a role keyword to save.
wizard.done: Set up. We'll watch this search daily.

settings.totp.heading: Two-factor authentication
settings.totp.lead: Protect your account with a 6-digit code from an authenticator app (Aegis, 1Password, Google Authenticator).
settings.totp.enrollIntro: Scan this with your authenticator app, then enter the 6-digit code below.

admin.testers.lead: Give testers their email, password, and the app URL. They never need server access.
admin.invite.heading: Send invitation
admin.invite.lead: Email a single-use link that lets the recipient choose their own password. Expires in 48 hours.
admin.invite.outboxNote: If SMTP is not configured, the invite link is written to the email outbox file shown in Settings.

findJobs.lead: Tell us what you want. We search Arbeitnow, Remotive, We Work Remotely, The Muse, and Hacker News “Who is hiring?” at once and show one ranked queue.
findJobs.empty: No results yet. Try a different query or location.
settings.bookmarklet.heading: Capture from Indeed / LinkedIn / StepStone / Xing
settings.bookmarklet.lead: Drag the link below to your bookmark bar. When you're on a job page on those platforms, click it to send the job to your DirectJob queue. Your browser does the read; we never scrape those sites.
settings.bookmarklet.howto: After dragging, visit any Indeed, LinkedIn, StepStone, or Xing job page and click the bookmark. The page opens DirectJob in a new tab and adds the job to your queue.
capture.merged: Already in your queue — added this URL as another source.
capture.bad_url: That URL didn't look like a job page.
capture.needs_login: Sign in first, then click the bookmarklet again.
